name: Womrik
description: Womrik was a planet located within the Womrik system in the Dufilvian sector of the Mid Rim, near New Cov. The sights of its ice-capped mountain peaks, which were second to none, attracted many tourists and were a source of pride the planet's inhabitants.
lead_paragraphs: Womrik was a planet located within the Womrik system in the Dufilvian sector of the Mid Rim, near New Cov. The sights of its ice-capped mountain peaks, which were second to none, attracted many tourists and were a source of pride the planet's inhabitants.
Garm Bel Iblis used it as a location for Peregrine's Nest.
